name: 需求计划 (7JF)
description_en_html:
Overview

Service parts planning primarily follows a make-to-stock or procure-to-stock process, driven by forecasts. These forecasts guide the procurement and replenishment of service parts, playing a crucial role in determining safety stock levels. The forecasting process relies on aggregated demand history, which includes necessary adjustments and interactive changes.

As a demand planner, you can:

  • Load historical demand data into the Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) solution
  • Source data from ERP systems (for example, SD or MM tables) using standard interfaces and reports
  • Upload data directly via Excel to gain full visibility across the supply chain network (Bill of Distribution)

As a demand planning expert, you can:

  • Apply traditional time-series forecasting, regression models, and advanced machine learning algorithms (such as ARIMA/ARIMAX, GBDT, and SESO) for forecast creation
  • Leverage automatic model selection to identify optimal forecasting models based on demand patterns such as slow-moving items, sporadic demand, and seasonality
  • Combine automated, exception-based planning with manual planning using interactive forecasting tools
  • Execute both local and global demand planning based on role-specific responsibilities

Forecasts for active, planned location products include demand in absolute terms (such as the number of pieces), as well as forecasts for the number of order items and the average demand per order item.

Key Process Flow

  • Collect and clean historical data
  • Perform statistical forecast
  • Approve the results of the forecast
  • Introduce external factors via time series that influence forecast
  • Generate a newly adopted demand plan

Business Benefits

  • Achieve a high-quality forecast with advanced machine learning models like ARIMA/ARMIAX, GBDT and SESO, particularly for sporadic time series data.
  • Improve service levels, reduce stock-outs and lower expediting costs through more accurate forecasts
  • Reduce inventory targets by lowering forecast errors
description_zh_html:
概览

服务部件计划主要遵循按库存生产或按库存采购流程，由预测驱动。这些预测指导服务部件的采购和补货，在确定安全库存级别方面发挥着关键作用。预测流程依赖于聚合需求历史记录，其中包括必要的调整和交互式更改。

作为需求计划员，您可以：

  • 将历史需求数据加载到扩展服务备件计划 (eSPP) 解决方案
  • 使用标准接口和报表的 ERP 系统（例如，SD 或 MM 表）中的源数据
  • 直接通过 Excel 上载数据，以全面了解整个供应链网络（分销清单）

作为需求计划专家，您可以：

  • 应用传统时间序列预测、回归模型和高级机器学习算法（例如 ARIMA/ARIMAX、GBDT 和 SESO）来创建预测
  • 利用自动模型选择，根据需求模式（如低周转项目、零星需求和季节性）识别最佳预测模型
  • 使用交互式预测工具，将基于异常的自动化计划与手动计划相结合
  • 基于角色特定的职责，执行本地和全球需求计划

活动、计划位置产品的预测包括绝对需求（例如件数），以及订单项目数量和每个订单项目的平均需求的预测。

关键流程流

  • 收集和清理历史数据
  • 执行统计预测
  • 批准预测结果
  • 通过影响预测的时间序列引入外部因素
  • 生成新采用的需求计划

业务优势

  • 通过 ARIMA/ARMIAX、GBDT 和 SESO 等高级机器学习模型实现高质量预测，尤其是对于零星时间序列数据。
  • 通过更准确的预测，提高服务水平，减少缺货并降低加急成本
  • 通过减少预测误差降低库存目标
